site.title: Hyeon Jun Lim
site.description: Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company. Reinforcement learning, end-to-end planning, and LiDAR perception for autonomous driving.

profile.name: Hyeon Jun Lim
profile.affiliation: Autonomous Driving Development, Hyundai Motor Company
bio: I am a Senior Research Engineer in the Autonomous Driving Development division at Hyundai Motor Company, with 7+ years of experience spanning robotics research and production-grade autonomous platforms.

My work centers on reinforcement learning, Transformer-based end-to-end planning, and high-reliability decision-making for self-driving vehicles. I architect closed-loop simulation environments, build LiDAR-based perception and 3D reconstruction systems, and take algorithms all the way onto real vehicles.

Previously, I built South Korea's first large-scale, high-precision LiDAR dataset for autonomous driving (1M+ labeled objects) at KITECH, and designed LiDAR simulation frameworks for sensor development, HD mapping, and high-fidelity 3D scanning. My academic foundation is in T-S fuzzy-based robust control and state estimation from Yonsei University.

news.text: Served as a reviewer for Journal of Electrical Engineering & Technology (JEET, IF 1.6).
Started a new project on a unified closed-loop simulation framework for RL-based autonomous driving.
Filed a patent on AI- and multi-sensor-based object detection data processing (KR / US / CN).
Filed three patents on vehicle control and adaptive 3D sensor calibration (KR / US / DE / CN).
Promoted to Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company.

projects.title: Unified Closed-Loop Simulation Framework for RL-Based Autonomous Driving
highlights: Architected a high-fidelity closed-loop simulation stack combining 3DGS-based photorealistic environments, rule-driven reward modeling, and World-Model-powered synthetic data generation for reactive long-tail scenario evaluation.

Optimized and validated real-world driving policies by integrating online/offline RL, designing specialized transfer layers, and deploying agents on physical vehicles — with major gains in success rate, safety, and collision avoidance.

projects.title: End-to-End Autonomous Planning System
highlights: Led end-to-end driving software development, embedded deployment, and real-world validation of a Transformer-based planner, including the first-ever on-vehicle control with the system.
Built a unified training/inference framework, closed-loop evaluation with high-fidelity synthetic data, and custom real-time visualization and debugging tools used across diverse real-vehicle tests.

projects.title: Lv.3 / Lv.4 Autonomous Driving Perception Systems (HDP & Robo-Services)
highlights: Led architecture, development, and deployment of the company's LiDAR perception stack, and established the first systematic sensor-evaluation framework benchmarking 10+ vendors.
Developed core parsing, filtering, fault-detection, clustering, localization, and calibration technologies including online optical-flow calibration, with CUDA-optimized embedded performance.
Validated across Lv.3/Lv.4 platforms: Genesis G90, Kia EV9, and RoboRide / RoboShuttle / RoboDelivery services.

projects.title: River Management Technology Using a Drone-Based Survey Platform
highlights: Developed a high-fidelity LiDAR simulation and analysis framework to derive optimal hardware specifications and validate dual-wavelength bathymetric sensing performance.
Translated point-cloud-based error modeling into actionable embedded-system requirements for high-accuracy river and subsurface mapping.

projects.title: Standardized Open Database and Evaluation System for Intelligent Vehicle Perception
highlights: Built South Korea's first large-scale, high-precision LiDAR dataset for autonomous driving — a million-label 128-channel corpus with automated annotation (90% time reduction) and long-tail extreme-condition captures.
Delivered cm-level HD mapping with custom tooling (LAS converter, point-wise sync, SOR filtering, rolling-shutter correction) and a full-stack calibrated sensor-logging platform.
Improved Z-axis accuracy from 10 cm to 1 cm via global ground-fitting, and benchmarked SOTA deep-learning models to confirm real-world robustness of the dataset.
projects.caption: Annotation viewer from the dataset build: 128-channel LiDAR point cloud with 3D object boxes (top), and the same objects projected into the synchronized front-left and rear-mid camera views.

projects.title: 3D Vehicle Shape Generation System for Automated Car Wash
highlights: Developed a fast, sub-2 cm-accuracy 3D vehicle-profiling system for unmanned car-wash automation, integrating custom multi-LiDAR sensing and fused point-cloud reconstruction.
Delivered real-time TI-embedded processing for reliable geometry extraction and collision-free operation.
